GFZ_KP.role: quiet and moderate daily activity selection

RICHARDSON_CANE_ICME.role: exclude cataloged disturbances from quiet/moderate dates and select isolated or complex event intervals

selection_pool.reason: complete pre-Gannon three-mission era with independent event-catalog coverage

QUIET_SOLAR_WIND.criteria: GFZ daily Kp maximum <=2.0 and daily Kp mean <=1.0; no Richardson-Cane disturbance or ICME interval in the one-day-expanded exclusion window; deterministic activity rank, year diversity, and >=60-day spacing

MODERATE_VARIABILITY.criteria: GFZ daily Kp maximum between 3.0 and 4.0 inclusive and daily Kp mean between 1.0 and 2.5 inclusive; no Richardson-Cane disturbance or ICME interval in the one-day-expanded exclusion window; deterministic target-activity rank, year diversity, and >=60-day spacing

ISOLATED_SHOCK_OR_SHEATH.criteria: Richardson-Cane disturbance/ICME entry with >=120 hours to the nearest listed disturbance and catalog ICME duration between 6 and 96 hours; 24-hour interval begins six hours before the disturbance; deterministic isolation rank, year diversity, and >=75-day spacing

COMPLEX_INTERACTING_EJECTA.criteria: at least two Richardson-Cane disturbance entries begin within 48 hours; 24-hour interval centered on the midpoint of the first two disturbances; deterministic member-count/time-span rank, year diversity, and >=75-day spacing

interpretation_limits: Kp quiet does not prove featureless upstream L1 plasma
absence from one ICME catalog does not prove absence of every uncataloged structure
isolated means isolated under the named catalog and frozen gap rule
complex means multiple catalog entries under the frozen 48-hour rule, not a physical-topology classification
mission-era tags do not guarantee product retrieval; later source failure remains INCOMPLETE_MULTIPOINT
no holdout interval may be replaced after spacecraft MAG, gate, or clustering inspection
no geometry, MVA, propagation, common-surface, or physical-class analysis is authorized by this selection stage
